name: Kiyomizu-dera Temple
description: A historic temple complex in eastern Kyoto known for its wooden Main Hall stage, hillside views, and Otowa waterfall.
highlights: Otowa waterfall and the temple hillside

highlights: 東山を代表する文化散策
